script_text: Neptune is activating your 12th House this week, Pisces, and the universe is about to shift beneath you. Early week, Saturn in your 1st House forms a tense square to Mercury in Leo, making communication foggy on Monday and Tuesday. Wednesday brings the Sun opposing Neptune, so your Water element intuition is sharp but emotions run high — avoid signing contracts. Midweek, Venus enters your 5th House on Thursday, igniting creative energy and opening a romantic doorway that has been sealed all month. Late week, Mars in Aries trines your 9th House, fueling bold career moves and travel opportunities that arrive Friday through Sunday. Thursday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House, activating romance and creativity. Monday is your worst day because Saturn squares Mercury, causing communication breakdowns. Channel this Neptune energy into deep journaling rather than impulsive decisions. Follow for daily updates.
